subject.title: openclaw doctor should detect stale gateway lock files

question: Should maintainers adopt/rebase the open linked fork PR, replace it with a fresh narrow fix, or defer this doctor coverage?
rationale: The bug remains source-reproducible, but the existing implementation candidate is conflicting and not maintainer-editable, so automation should not open a competing fix until a maintainer chooses the path.

options.title: Replace or adopt the fix
options.body: Create a maintainer-owned narrow fix, or adopt the linked implementation after resolving conflicts and review concerns.

options.title: Ask for a rebase
options.body: Have the fork PR author rebase and provide current proof before using it as the landing path.

options.title: Defer doctor coverage
options.body: Leave runtime startup recovery as the only protection and keep this issue open or reprioritized for later.

recommendation.title: Replace or adopt the fix
recommendation.body: Create a maintainer-owned narrow fix, or adopt the linked implementation after resolving conflicts and review concerns.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history ties this decision to the gateway lock implementation and doctor contribution flow.
